name: BD-15959
description: BD-15959 was an OOM-series security droid in the Separatist Droid Army stationed on a Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel during the Clone Wars. The droid was destroyed by Anakin Skywalker when Obi-Wan Kenobi escaped from his prison cell.
